title: Hung
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, vintage Christmas in an old house, glowing tree lights and hand-blown glass ornaments, deep red and gold tones with cold blue shadows, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 4. She locked it in the car. She woke up and it was on the tree. 🎁

Original fiction. Part 5 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Holly learned eleven families vanished on Christmas Eve, and the twelfth ornament is meant for her.
scenes.image: a glowing glass ornament in a velvet box beside a dark window

scenes.narration: She swore she wouldn't sleep. She locked the box in the trunk of her car and sat on the couch with coffee and every light on.
scenes.image: woman on a couch wrapped in a blanket with a mug of coffee, every lamp in the room switched on

scenes.narration: She remembers three in the morning. She doesn't remember three-oh-one.
scenes.image: a coffee mug tipped over on a rug beside a sleeping woman's dangling hand

scenes.narration: She woke to the tree lights blinking. Blue. Slow. Like breathing.
scenes.image: a Christmas tree with softly pulsing blue lights in a dark living room

scenes.narration: The car was still locked. The box was still in the trunk. The twelfth slot was empty.
scenes.image: open velvet ornament box in a car trunk dusted with snow, one slot empty

scenes.narration: It was on the tree. Front and center, at eye level. The hook bent in a neat little curl. The way she bends them.
scenes.image: a single glowing glass ornament hanging at eye level on a blue-lit Christmas tree

scenes.narration: Whatever hung it knew exactly how she decorates.
scenes.image: close-up of a wire ornament hook bent into a neat curl around a pine branch

scenes.narration: Inside the glass, her living room was dark now. Christmas Eve dark. Snow in the window. And the tiny Holly was gone. In her place stood a tall thin figure in a long coat.
scenes.image: inside a glass ornament, a tall thin figure in a long dark coat standing beside a tiny Christmas tree

scenes.narration: She tried to pull it down. The hook wouldn't come off the branch. The branch wouldn't break. The glass was so cold it burned her fingers.
scenes.image: woman's hands straining to pull a glowing ornament from a tree branch, frost on her fingertips

scenes.narration: Christmas Eve was tomorrow. And on the window behind the tree, frost was spreading in the shape of a hand. From the inside.
scenes.image: frost forming the shape of a hand on the inside of a window behind a lit Christmas tree
